{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
Summon a divine sword that cleaves the battlefield for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT}{/c} damage. 

Casting {c_important}Zenith{/c} again cuts through the battlefield for {c_number}{payload:LAST_HIT_TOOL}{/c} damage and Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:TOOLTIP_KNOCKDOWN}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Zenith{/c} is now also a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill that:
{icon:bullet,1.2}Dashes to enemies
{icon:bullet,1.2}Gains {c_number}[{SF_27} * 100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage

{c_important}Zenith{/c} unleashes your wrath, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_B}{/c} damage and can be cast indefinitely for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_B_RECAST_ATTK1}{/c} seconds before starting its Cooldown.

Instead of Knocking Down enemies, {c_important}Zenith's{/c} 2nd strike extends this duration by {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} second.

{c_important}Zenith{/c} sunders a rift in the ground with a single strike, Knocking Down enemies and dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_C_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.

After {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} second, the rift detonates for {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_C_FINAL_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage.
Killing {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies with {c_important}Zenith{/c} reduces its cooldown by {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Zenith{/c} increases your {c_number}[{SF_37} * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE3_CRIT_CHANCE}{/c} seconds.
